title: Hero buttons: two at most, no button types, no Primary switch
recommendation: Cap the hero at two buttons edited as one list (label and link), first one primary, and delete the Sign / Payment / Custom types and the Primary switch without changing storage or tracking ids.

questions.q: Hard cap at two in the editor, with existing three- and four-button pages left as they are until edited?
questions.recommended: Yes. 6 recent customer pages and 201 all-time live pages render three or more. Leave them rendering; the editor simply offers no further add.

questions.q: Do Sign and Payment need to stay as named types for any integration, or are they plain links?
questions.recommended: Plain links. Nothing in the renderer or the workers treats them differently beyond the tracking id, which stays.

questions.q: Default labels for the two buttons: "Book a call" and "Learn more"?
questions.recommended: Yes. U06 already changes the fallback and seeds to these tonight; this item only removes the type menu around them.
